displayName: IKEA API - Prices by Country, Product Data, Stock by Store, Reviews
description: IKEA API for IKEA prices by country - one article number priced on 2 to 10 IKEA country sites in one call, each in its own currency (never converted); search and category listings with sorts, facets and filters (color, price range, new, last chance, IKEA Family price, best seller, store availability); one product in full (price, previous price, IKEA Family price, measurements, materials, packages, assembly PDFs, variants, ratings); the 20 newest reviews with sub-ratings; deal lists (new lower price, last chance, IKEA Family price, new products); the category tree; search suggestions; stores with hours; stock level at one store for up to 100 article numbers; batch item lookup; and As-is second-hand offers by store. 55 markets for search and product. 12 endpoints, 1 credit each (compare 1 per market).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
